About Coupang
At Coupang, we're revolutionizing the e-commerce experience, from the moment a customer opens our app to the moment their order arrives. Our retail and logistics network has shattered the tradeoffs between speed, selection, and price. In Coupang, we're rapidly scaling our Rocket Delivery and Rocket Overseas services in Taiwan.
The role
We're hiring a Senior PM to join our Supply Chain Management technology team, leading the design, development, and localization of Coupang's supply chain management products. In this role, you'll own one or more product areas across ordering, inbound placement and schedule, inventory management, transfers, and network design — the systems that decide what to buy, where to send it, when, and how to move it across our FC network. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy in an ambiguous environment, partnering with data science, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to ship measurable outcomes.
The work is science-heavy
Most of what you'll ship has a mathematical model, optimization, ML, or agentic decision-model component at its core. Our architecture combines LLM-based agents with deterministic MIP solvers and ML models: LLMs orchestrate the workflow; solvers and ML models compute the answer. You'll partner daily with our SCM engineering and data science teams, who together own the systems, models, and solvers. Your job is to shape what those systems decide, what they optimize for, and where they hand off to human stakeholders.
What you'll do
Own what to build and why for your product area(s).
Write PRDs: problem statement, goals and metrics, scope (in/out), functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, open questions.
Own the product roadmap, backlog, and KPIs end-to-end. Prioritize and sequence with reasoning documented; make scope tradeoffs in writing.
Drive PRD sign-off with the right stakeholders (retail/catalog, warehouse operations, instock, category management, S&OP, inbound planning) on business use cases, scope, and exit criteria. Align parity/disparity decisions with your counterpart PMs.
Conduct UAT against the acceptance criteria you wrote, a functional check that the feature meets requirements.
Work directly with business and operations stakeholders.
Instock managers, S&OP, IPC/CT, category managers, buyers, and FC operations are your primary customers. You'll spend real time with them, sitting with instock manages, buyers, and planners, walking FC floors, understanding what actually breaks. Translate operational pain into product bets. Serve as the strategic bridge between local operations, business teams, and global tech.
Ship AI/ML/OR-integrated products from ideation to launch.
Partner with data science and engineering on ordering, scheduling, placement, inventory rebalancing, and other decision systems in our AI-enabled fulfillment centers. Define success metrics, drive A/B testing, and iterate based on real-time data.
Identify new opportunities across ordering, fulfillment planning, inventory management, and network design.
Deeply analyze data, including unstructured operational data, to size levers and drive cost efficiencies.
Prototype rapidly.
Use AI tools and advanced analytics to reduce time from ideation to proof-old the first-pass analysis, run the numbers yourself.
You should have
Bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative discipline.
5+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of shipping products at scale. E-commerce, logistics, or supply chain tech are strongly preferred.
Shipped at least one non-trivial optimization or ML-backed product to production (e.g., procurement, routing, dynamic pricing etc.).
Fluency in English: reading, writing, and speaking. You will write PRDs, technical specs, and executive updates in English, and work daily with global engineering and DS teams in English.
Proven ability to translate complex operational processes into scalable, AI-integrated business solutions from conception to deployment.
A forward-thinking mindset with a strong ability to use AI tools (GenAI, LLMs, agents) to accelerate product development, extract insights from unstructured data, and prototype hypotheses.
Hands-on data fluency. SQL to the level of writing your own analysis queries.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, and collaborate effectively with data science, engineering, and operational teams.
A relentless bias for action and ownership. Willingness to bridge high-level strategy and tactical operational execution.
Nice to have
Deep experience designing and launching advanced planning products (fulfillment center planning, automated inventory management, route scheduling, network capacity design).
Experience with vendor-facing systems (e.g., SRMS, PO management) and inbound planning and operations.
Experience shipping AI-agent products — spec'ing an agent's tools, guardrails, and human handoffs.
Python enough to prototype and read DS code.

You will own and evolve workforce planning methodologies, lead complex scenario planning, and translate workforce data into executive-ready recommendations that influence staffing decisions.

THE JOB

Live Nation Entertainment's Media & Sponsorship Division seeks a highly analytical and detail-oriented Sales Commission Analyst to support the administration and execution of the division's sales commission function.

This role is responsible for reporting, administering, reconciling, and analyzing sales compensation across the division. Working closely with Finance, Sales, Sales Systems Operations, and HR, this person will translate approved compensation plans into operational processes, maintain accurate commission data, execute adjustments, and provide timely reporting and analysis to support the business.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with complex data, and able to manage recurring deadlines and high-stakes financial calculations with a high degree of accuracy.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

• Administer approved annual sales compensation plans, implementing plan structures, rates, splits, advances, draws, and reconciliation schedules within the commission platform.
• Maintain commission plan configurations within the platform, including formula updates, seller onboarding/offboarding, testing, and ongoing administrative changes based on approved plan decisions.
• Execute commission administration including seller and manager access, approval tracking, dispute resolution, and updates to earnings information throughout the year.
• Execute Salesforce data adjustments required for accurate commission calculations, including overrides, exceptions, splits, Regional Multi-Year Bonus qualifications, deal prorations, Division AOI and Teams Goals tracking, and bi-weekly data quality checks.
• Perform quarterly and annual commission reconciliations to validate calculations, identify discrepancies, and support accurate and timely payments.
• Produce bi-weekly executive scorecards and compensation reports summarizing sales performance, commissions, and payment obligations.
• Analyze historical compensation and sales data to identify trends, variances, data issues, and opportunities for improved reporting and accuracy.
• Support annual budget reporting and forecasting by providing commission data, historical trends, and analysis to Finance and Sales leadership.
• Maintain commission dashboards and reporting by combining data from Salesforce, the commission platform, and other business systems.
• Support scenario analysis and modeling to help Sales and Finance understand the potential compensation impact of business and performance changes.
• Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for commission calculations, payments, adjustments, advances, and exceptions.
• Coordinate with third-party commission platform vendors on system issues, licensing, renewals, and user administration, escalating issues as needed.
• Respond to seller and manager questions regarding commission calculations, payments, reporting, and platform functionality, resolving issues or coordinating with the appropriate team.
• Maintain field guides, training materials, and communications related to commission processes, deadlines, payment timelines, and system updates.
• Identify and support process improvements, including opportunities for automation, improved reporting, and use of AI tools to increase accuracy and reduce manual effort.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Human Resources, Accounting, or a related field with 2–5 years of experience in sales compensation, financial analysis, sales operations, HR analytics, or a related analytical function.
• Experience administering or supporting a sales commission process, preferably within a commission management platform such as CIQ, Spiff, Xactly, CaptivateIQ, or comparable system.
• Strong Excel and data analysis skills, including pivot tables, lookups, data validation, reconciliation, and the ability to analyze complex payout calculations.
• Experience working with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, with an understanding of how CRM data flows into downstream reporting and commission calculations.
• Experience with BI and reporting tools and the ability to build and maintain management-facing reports and dashboards.
• Understanding of sales compensation concepts including commissions, draws, advances, splits, multi-year deals, prorations, exceptions, and reconciliations.
• Exceptional attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy when working with confidential compensation and financial information.
• Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage recurring reporting cycles, payment deadlines, and multiple requests simultaneously.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify the underlying cause of data or calculation issues.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to explain compensation calculations and reporting results to sellers, managers, and cross-functional partners.

If you are ready to challenge yourself, accelerate your career, and give new hope to patients, there’s no better place than here at BMS with our Cell Therapy team.

Position Summary:

The Lead Manufacturing Associate, Cell Therapy brings enthusiasm, intellectual curiosity, scientific rigor, and a desire to help drive novel programs. The Lead Manufacturing Associate must be goal-oriented, flexible, and able to work efficiently with safety and quality in mind, with a good understanding of good manufacturing practices to support routine manufacturing operations for Cell Therapy.

Shifts Available:

6am – 6pm, rotating schedule including holidays and weekends

Responsibilities:

• Performing patient process unit operations and support operations described in standard operating procedures and batch records.
• Completing documentation required by process transfer protocols, validation protocols, standard operating procedures, and batch records.
• Performing tasks in a manner consistent with the safety policies, quality systems, and GMP requirements.
• Completing training assignments to ensure the necessary technical skills and knowledge.
• Working in a cleanroom environment and performing aseptic processing; maintain manufacturing environmental conditions (Non-Viable Particulate(s) and Viable microbial levels per controlled area classification specifications) by performing area disinfection regiment as required to meet global Health Authority requirements.
• Referencing Batch Records, Standard Operating Procedures and Work Instructions to successfully complete manufacturing operations.
• Demonstrating strong practical and theoretical knowledge of work.
• Solving complex problems; taking new perspectives using existing solutions
• Identifying innovation solutions
• Setting up manufacturing areas and equipment/fixtures; performing facility and equipment commissioning activities.
• Working closely with Manufacturing Managers to ensure seamless pass down and communication of operational status.
• Working with production planning and leadership to execute daily unit operations schedule that includes people, product, and material flow across multiple shifts.
• Helping ensure the shift works effectively in a team-based, cross-functional environment to complete all production tasks required by shift schedule.
• Collaborating with support groups on recommendations and solving technical problems.
• Supporting development of manufacturing operating procedures that are technically sound, promote effective and efficient operations, and comply with cGMP requirements.
• Supporting quality event investigations

Working Conditions:

• Stand and Walk - Required to stand/walk while operating manufacturing/computer equipment for several hours at a time, throughout the day.
• Carrying weight, Pushing, Pulling Lifting - Required to carry, lift, push, and/or pull up to 50 pounds several times a day while handling production equipment and/or materials.
• Climb - Required to climb (use of stepladders in production areas, or stairwells) several times a day.
• Bend and Kneel - Required to bend or kneel several times a day.
• Overhead work - Required to perform overhead reaching during handling of production materials/files/supplies up to 25 pounds several times a day, throughout the day.
• Moving Head and Neck – Required movement of head/neck while using computer applications and handling of production equipment and materials several times a day, throughout the day.
• Twisting - Required movement of twisting waist while setting up equipment several times a day, throughout the day.
• Repetitive Use - Required repetitive use of arms/wrists/hands while setting up equipment and processing several times a day, throughout the day.
• Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) and other clean room garments daily. This may include, but not limited to: safety shoes, safety glasses, aprons, face shields, lab coats, full body gowns, hairnets, gloves, and hearing protection.

Knowledge and Skills:

• Driven and motivated to learn and execute Cell Therapy Manufacturing operations
• Must have the ability to work assigned shift (Day, Night, Weekends and/or Holidays).
• Must be able to work in a cleanroom environment and perform aseptic processing.
• Must be comfortable being exposed to human blood components.
• Must be able to be in close proximity to strong magnets.
• Knowledge of cGMP regulations and FDA guidance applicable to biologics and cell therapy manufacturing.

Minimum Requirements:

• 4+ years of experience in cGMP bioprocessing manufacturing, cell therapy manufacturing or relevant experience.
• Bachelors in relevant science or engineering discipline, or equivalent in work experience.
• Experience in cell therapy manufacturing techniques, including cell washing processes, cell separation processes, cryopreservation processes, cell expansion processes using incubators and bioreactors, and automated equipment.
• Experience with aseptic processing in ISO 5 biosafety cabinets, universal precautions for handling human derived materials in BSL-2 containment areas is preferred.
